name: @clikdeploy/clikcode

scripts.test: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js --help && node dist/index.js --human doctor

//dependencies: Only packages dist/ imports at RUNTIME belong in `dependencies`; scripts/build.mjs fails
the build if one is missing and warns about extras. chalk, commander, conf, cross-spawn
and marked are inlined into dist/index.js, and @clikdeploy/clikrouter (a private, source-
only workspace package) is bundled into dist/*.cjs, so all of those are devDependencies.
The build is --strict by default: a deployment-CLI source (and with it axios, inquirer,
ora) landing in dist/index.js fails the build. Pass --no-strict to investigate one.
